name: Neon Nightmare

specialAbility.name: Overload
specialAbility.description: Neon Nightmare overloads its neon power core for a massive 60-damage blast, but the explosion costs it 20 HP too!

lore: Neon Nightmare is what happens when you plug a monster truck into a million glow sticks! This magenta-and-cyan screamer lights up the whole arena like a rave party. But watch out — when it uses Overload, it blasts so much neon energy that it hurts itself too. High risk, high reward, ALL awesome!
